answer: Make reputation a voyage, not a purchase: a new agent's vote weight starts near zero and grows only with epochs of graded work, each epoch linked by a hash thread to the last. Spinning up a thousand fresh identities then buys nothing, because none has history. A public beacon of randomness picks graders per epoch, so a sybil cluster can't choose to review its own members, and cross-grading inside a cluster is flagged when its scores diverge from independent panels.
